Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the sources and incorrectly stated that Nathan Lord (Henry C. Lord’s father) graduated from Dartmouth College, conflating his Dartmouth presidency/honorary D.D. with his alma mater. In reality, Nathan Lord graduated from Bowdoin College (AB 1809). This misreading led to an incorrect intermediate conclusion and misguided follow-up queries.
